  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):

  Details:
  Thread 31905 — Black King (CNPJ 50.042.585/0001-80) NF-e ↔ in-transit reconciliation, plus the Brazil export-lane tooling defects it surfaced.
  
  Delivered:
  - Crosswalk Rev 1→5: the 15 SEFAZ consulta-emitente NF-e joined against the Main Ledger `offchain assets in transit` arrival register. 12/15 resolved (10 tracking-matched on DANFE weight/content evidence; 2 cancelled/superseded). 3 (NF4/NF7/NF15) documented as never-shipped (Aug-2025 tariff disruption, corroborated by 4 independent evidence legs).
  - Main Ledger writes: `shipment_nfe!K` (Parcel Tracking Number) + `!L` (full-DANFE PDF links) + `offchain assets in transit!Q` (NF-e Chave), all snapshotted pre-write; one governor-directed revert (Kirsten↔Val Lapidus) exercised cleanly to a byte-identical snapshot.
  - Bilingual (EN/PT) invoice convention doc for Brazil / NF-e.
  - The reconciliation surfaced a missing R$1,050 expense record (Black King PGDAS-D fine) — root-caused to the EXPENSE_PROCESSING GAS webhook pointing at a load-broken deployment; repointed (tokenomics #524) and the record verified landed (offchain line 4317, hash b9744dcb939a486d, no duplicate).
  - GAS loadability/currency fixes: currency-label canonicalization + idempotent ledger append (#525, deployed v10), dead WIX accessor removal (#527), real deployment ids recorded in the project manifest (#528), pre-push remote-only-file delete guard (#520/#526), and an endpoint smoke-test harness (#523).
  
  Evidence PRs listed below; full detail in handoffs/HANDOFF_MANIFEST.md (row: BLACK_KING_NFE_TRANSIT_CROSSWALK.md).
